notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.4.0
notes.notes:
The issue revolving around varying monitor resolutions has been addressed and is corrected, please update your game if you haven't already.

If you find any other issues revolving around resolution or unclear instructions, don't hesitate to reach out to me at htintera@gmail.com

~Hunter

notes.title: Patching Resize Issues
notes.notes:
Currently am working on a fix to make sure that it does not go off the edge of the screen on smaller or larger resolution displays. This patch should be up by the end of the day, and I apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused anyone.

This issue resulted from having a fixed size for some of the features and will be fixed by tweaking specific areas of the UI.

Thank you for your patience in the resolution of this issue.
